title: Remove a duplicate dependency declaration so the build passes on Maven 3.10
body:
org.openmrs.module:webservices.rest-omod-common:tests is declared twice in dependencyManagement, the second time without a version. Maven 3.9 accepted it with a warning; Maven 3.10, now on the GitHub runner image, rejects it and the build fails before it starts. The resolved dependencies are unchanged. 

- `mvn validate` with Maven 3.10.0: fails before this change, passes after.
- `mvn dependency:list` with Maven 3.9.10: the resolved dependencies of every module are identical before and after.

core-3.x already does the same.

title: Upgrade to support OpenMRS Platform 3.0
body:
Updates metadatamapping so it builds against, and runs on, openmrs-core master (Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT: Java 21, Jakarta EE, Spring 7, Hibernate 7). It is needed by the emrapi Platform 3 upgrade. Same approach as the platform 3 upgrades of calculation (openmrs/openmrs-module-calculation#19), legacyui and webservices.rest.

## Changes
- Versions and build:
  - Module version is now 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT in all poms. It now uses Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT (`openmrs-bom` imported), REST 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT and legacyui 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT.
  - Builds with Java 21 and `-parameters`.
  - Surefire 3.5.4 so JUnit 5 runs.
  - The javax servlet and PowerMock bits are dropped.
  - The duplicate `webservices.rest-omod-common` tests entry is dropped from `dependencyManagement`. Maven 3.10.0, which GitHub's ubuntu-24.04 runner image now ships, rejects the POM with it.
- `config.xml` now sets `require_version` to 3.0.0.
- `HibernateMetadataMappingDAO` moves from the removed Hibernate Criteria API to HQL, with the same filters and ordering and the metadata-set item subquery kept. It now uses the plain `SessionFactory`:
  - Saves go through `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate`. That merges a detached entity into a new managed instance, so the batch saves return the instances it hands back.
  - Lookups by id use `Session.find`, since `Session.get` is deprecated for removal in Hibernate 7. Lookups by uuid use `HibernateUtil.getUniqueEntityByUUID`.
- `LocalMappingHibernateInterceptor` implements `Interceptor`, since `EmptyInterceptor` is gone. Ids are now `Object`.
- commons-lang becomes lang3, and `javax.servlet`/`javax.annotation` become `jakarta.*`.
- Tests move to JUnit 5. The REST operation tests' URIs lose a leading slash, because `/rest/v1//metadatamapping/...` is rejected by Spring 7's path matching.
- CI (release workflow and Bamboo) uses JDK 21.

## Depends on
- openmrs/openmrs-core#6631, merged on 2026-10-06. The `metadatamapping.MetadataMappingService` `TransactionProxyFactoryBean` references core services, which before #6631 left them without core's advisors (openmrs/openmrs-core#6630). Against a core snapshot from before it, `LocalMappingHibernateInterceptorTest` fails and the server can fail to start.

## Verification
- The api and omod tests pass on JDK 21 and 25, with Maven 3.9 and 3.10, against the published core 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, which includes #6631: api 87 tests, omod 47, with one test skipped in each, both already `@Ignore` upstream.
- On the first commit, with all 31 O3 reference application modules upgraded to Platform 3, on openmrs-core master plus the core fixes openmrs/openmrs-core#6629, #6631, #6633, #6635, #6637 and #6639 (`mvn jetty:run`, MySQL 8): every module starts, logging in through the UI works, and core message codes resolve.
- There, `GET /ws/rest/v1/metadatamapping/source` returns 200, and anonymous calls to core services are rejected with 401, so core's authorization advice is intact.

title: (docs) Replace the dead Travis badge with the GitHub Actions one
body:
The README badge still points at travis-ci.org, which shut down and now redirects to a 404, so the badge renders blank. This module builds on GitHub Actions via build.yml, so this points the badge and its link there.

Heads up that the badge will show red right now: the latest build.yml run on master failed on 2026-09-03 on the OWASP dependency check job, not the Maven build.

title: Separate OWASP dependency check into its own job
body:
## Summary
- Separate OWASP dependency check into a standalone workflow job
- OWASP check only runs on push and workflow_dispatch (not on PRs)
- Build job no longer runs the OWASP check inline or needs the NVD_API_KEY secret

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify build job still passes
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check runs on push to the default branch
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check does not run on pull requests
